title: Ae shahe do jaha'n khudahafiz
body:
Ae shahe do jahaa'n khudahafiz
ae mohammed ki jaa'n khudahafiz
<<DIVIDER>>
Ham shabeehe nabi hussain ke laal
akbare noujawaa'nkhudahafiz
<<DIVIDER>>
Ae shahedee'n ke tashnalab yaawar
asghare be zabaa'n khudahafiz
<<DIVIDER>>
pherne waale khushk hoto'n par
apni sookhi zabaa'n khudahafiz
<<DIVIDER>>
paaemaale gham o alam qasim
jaao shabbar ki jaa'n khudahafiz
<<DIVIDER>>
ae alamdaare fouj ae abbas
ae ali ke nashaa'n khudahafiz
<<DIVIDER>>
ho chuki aaj qatm mehmaani
shiyo'n ke mehmaa'n khudahafiz
